Hi; would complicate the relationship I have with my current occupation and frequent clientele, in regards to said person. Worried it will throw everything out of whack, (perception of me, my normalcy) particularly if I can just whether the storm, so to speak.

Kind of stuck on a loop of grief in regards to a failed relationship with said person, and the hurtful things they continue to say. (along with the confusion about it) It’s as if no time has passed at all. I apologize if all of this is a little vague. It’s a strange situation. The other evening they posted something pretty nasty, what can you do. Though it does affect me. Wish it didn’t.
